criteria.behavior: Production camera inference uses the reviewed node/Core ML runtime and measured detector fallback.
criteria.check: Run scripts/verification-lane.sh p8 after M1 implements the mode; inspect actual production imports/process wiring and .agent/results/P8/contract-review.md.
criteria.expected: Nonempty runtime/host suites pass; node/model versions and licenses are pinned. Backend/readiness reports describe the runtime actually executing, not only the spike.

criteria.behavior: IPC, bounded frame queues and process/camera recovery reject invalid and stale output.
criteria.check: Run p8 cases for no-face, late frame, utility crash, invalid resource/tensor, camera loss and old generation; inspect source-review.md and recovery.json.
criteria.expected: No stale gaze target is admitted; resources and queues remain bounded; errors/fallback are observable and cannot claim native readiness incorrectly.

criteria.behavior: Calibration persists with compatible camera/model/display identity and target feedback remains truthful.
criteria.check: Inspect calibration/recovery cases and real-app feedback after restart, wake and display changes in .agent/results/P8/recovery.json.
criteria.expected: Valid calibration survives; incompatible state is rejected with a drift/recalibration remedy. Hover/confidence does not actuate a target.

criteria.behavior: The complete real-camera pipeline meets active FPS, wake and first-calibration requirements on M1/8GB.
criteria.check: Run the planned p8-live lane under scripts/with-desktop-lock.py after live authorization; inspect qualification.json, frame/recovery rows and frozen calibration-attempt population.
criteria.expected: >=15fps camera-to-target, wake <=5s, >=80% first-try calibration; actual camera/human evidence and sample counts, not seeded model-inference rates.

criteria.behavior: Speech, app, driver and tracker together satisfy resource and recovery requirements.
criteria.check: Inspect combined-runtime resource series, queue/frame-age observations, failure controls and manifest in P8 qualification evidence.
criteria.expected: PROGRAM steady RSS <=2.5GB and idle CPU <=10% with declared normal configuration; no hidden tracking disablement. Supplemental footprint is distinguished from RSS.

criteria.behavior: Independent review and a complete cross-worktree handoff support production promotion.
criteria.check: Inspect P8 source/final judge verdict, serialized integration checks, signed runtime/model identities and human calibration checklist.
criteria.expected: Authorized independent PASS with no unresolved finding; source, fixture, camera and physical evidence are not conflated. Prior runtime remains recoverable.
